title: Catalog, caches, extensions, runtime
caption: Catalog tables on disk fill in-memory caches, which feed function calls into built-in and extension code, with memory contexts and error handling on the side.

title: Lookup, call, error, invalidate
caption: Follow numbers 1 to 8 to see a function call found through the caches, then an error cleaned up, then stale cache rows dropped.

badges.meaning: Backend start sets up the catalog caches (InitCatalogCache).
Code looks up a catalog row with SearchSysCache1; a miss reads pg_proc from disk.
fmgr_info finds the C function and fills FmgrInfo.
FunctionCall1Coll calls the function and gets a Datum back.
The function allocates memory with palloc in the current memory context.
MemoryContextReset frees everything in the context at once.
After a catalog change, other backends drop stale cache rows (inval.c).

title: Memory context tree and node
caption: Memory contexts form a tree under TopMemoryContext, and each node is a MemoryContextData struct whose reset frees all its chunks.
